scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && bun run check:types && bun run check:frontend && echo "Checking Backend..." && cd src-tauri && cargo check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:frontend: echo "Checking Frontend Syntax..." && bunx biome check .
scripts.clean: rm -rf .context .feeds .svelte-kit build node_modules src-tauri/gen src-tauri/target coverage .pkg/src .pkg/pkg .pkg/feedmee .pkg/*.pkg.tar.zst .pkg/*.zst .pkg/*.gz
scripts.format: bunx biome format --write . && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt
scripts.format:check: bunx biome format . && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt -- --check
scripts.package: bun run build && mkdir -p .pkg && cp PKGBUILD .pkg/ && cd .pkg && makepkg -si --noconfirm --force
scripts.test: echo "Running Tests..." && vitest run && cd src-tauri && cargo test
scripts.update: bun update --latest && cd src-tauri && cargo upgrade && cargo update --verbose
